chapter_number.means: the chapter's number above its title (“I”…; empty — the prologue, the epilogue, the whole play, the very beginning)

chapter_title.means: the chapter's title, coming through on the sail (empty with the number — the very beginning: only the yacht)

map.means: null — only the title on one great sail; else the rows of choices: [{title, weight '⚑'|'~', options: [{label, state: 'chosen'|'open'|'unseen'}]}] — a sail for each option: the chosen one scarlet and glowing, the open one a white outline, the unreached one a barely seen dot with no word

reveal.means: how far the mist has gone: 0 — all in mist, 1 — the mist has gone off the sea to the very bottom of the frame; the title and the rows come through as it goes

yacht.means: the brightness of the yacht at the bottom edge (the element yacht, which its game offers to press)
